title: Storage & disk diagnostics
tips: `df -h` shows volume free space; Local Snapshots can hide reclaimable space.
Purge Time Machine local snapshots with `tmutil thinlocalsnapshots / 10000000000 4`.
SMART warnings from diskutil or system_profiler indicate impending drive failure.
External volumes that won't mount often need First Aid in Disk Utility first.
I/O errors in Console.app frequently point to failing media or bad cables.
